artDirection.medium: Project-local vector shapes arranged like a friendly hand-drawn classroom explainer.
artDirection.palette: Deep navy background, warm ivory surfaces, cyan data marks, coral corrections, and lime success accents.
artDirection.lighting: Flat graphic lighting with soft local glows only around the active concept.
artDirection.texture: Subtle procedural paper grain and imperfect vector strokes; no external textures.
artDirection.compositionGrammar: One large central concept per Scene, with a persistent left-to-right data-to-prediction pathway and generous vertical spacing.
artDirection.motionLanguage: Frame-driven drawing reveals, flowing dots, parameter adjustments, and gentle spring emphasis tied to the causal explanation.
artDirection.typography: Large rounded Simplified Chinese labels with short phrases, high contrast, and no duplication of top-level captions.

continuityRules: Carry the same cyan data dots and lime model node through the complete explanation.
Build the data-to-training-to-model-to-prediction pathway progressively across Scenes.
Keep semantic labels inside the frozen Scene content frame and leave the top-level caption band unobstructed.
Use coral only for errors, corrections, or bias warnings; use lime only for learned output or verified prediction.
forbiddenTreatments: No photorealistic robots, glowing brains, or imagery that implies human-like machine consciousness.
No dense dashboards, code listings, equations, or tiny technical annotations.
No remote media, historical project assets, CSS animation, CSS transitions, or animation utility classes.
No Scene-rendered narration captions or text inside the reserved caption band.
